name: env-scanner
title: Environmental Scanner
author: cindra
description: Standalone circuit-network hub: a buildable Environmental Scanner that reads its surface and outputs day/night position, daylight fraction, tick-of-day, and solar output as circuit signals on ANY planet. Situational, not strictly-better than a clock; native/chemistry-free recipe. Optionally emits a Cindra solar-flare forecast (next-flare countdown + phase + intensity) when the Cindra flare system is present, via a documented remote interface; degrades gracefully when absent.
